rows.en: A mother is still a woman!
A woman has to keep shining!

(I just sort of wandered into the hangar...
I don't want to get in anyone's way,
so it feels kind of awkward.)
(I went out for an aimless wander, but...)

My head hurts...
Maybe I'll skip the shopping
and head home early...

rows.notes: Speaker plate ??? (woman); scene file ext_gra = Grace, name not revealed in the text.

rows.en:
Hmm, I think you must have me
confused with someone else...?

(My head's all foggy,
I can't remember...)
You don't look well, do you?

rows.notes: hai answers 'you look unwell' in the affirmative; English 'No' agrees with 'you don't look well, do you?'.

rows.en:
Shall I recommend a hospital that'll
leave you feeling refreshed?
rows.notes: sukkiri ('refreshed', clear-headed) is the running gag of the ext_gra scenes; rendered 'refresh(ed)' throughout.

rows.en:
Yes, just a little treatment and you'll
feel refreshed. Back home the same day,
no pain, and free of charge, of course.
rows.notes: Three JP lines reflowed into three English lines (same count); roha = old slang for 'free'.

rows.en: Back home the same day, no pain... free...

It's all right...
Just leave yourself in my hands...
(If anything, I feel better than usual!)
Thank you, miss... whoever you are!
rows.notes: mizu shirazu no o-nee-san (a stranger) -> 'miss', per brief.

rows.en: Well then, until we meet again.

(Maybe I'll grab some hippo-cow milk
on the way home!)
rows.notes: kaba-ushi (a Frontier livestock animal, lit. 'hippo cow') is not in the glossary; 'hippo-cow' used provisionally.

rows.en: Huh...? Something's wrong with my body...
(I think I feel even worse than before...)
Oh dear, looks like they botched it...
rows.notes: aitsura ('those guys'): unseen accomplices; 'they' kept vague as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Oh... No, it's nothing at all,
ohohohoho!!
(Sigh... I'll just go home and stay in bed...)

Yes, I'll just rest at home...
I'm sorry, after you went to the trouble
of recommending it...

Tch!
...Oh well. It'd be bad to drag you
there by force.
(D-did I just hear her click her tongue...?)
Well, take good care of yourself, then!!
rows.notes: seizei daiji ni suru koto ne: sarcastic, spiteful send-off.

rows.en: (If anything, I feel better than usual!)

(Maybe I'll grab some hippo-cow milk
on the way home!)

(I went out for another aimless wander,
but...)
Yes, I can't find my way...

I know!
Why not get refreshed so you'll know
the way?

Yes, a refreshing brain refresh.
You'll know your way around the whole
Macross perfectly.
rows.notes: Macross = the Macross Frontier ship the story takes place in.

rows.en: What do you say? Want to get refreshed?
I want to get refreshed again!

It's all right, just leave yourself
in my hands.

(Refreshed doesn't even begin to cover it!
I feel like I can see the whole galaxy,
not just the Macross!!)

(Maybe I'll grab some hippo-cow ice cream
on the way home!)
Huh...? Something's wrong with my head...

Where am I?
Huh? Huh? Huuuh??

Yes, I'll try to sort it out on my own.
I'm sorry, after you went to the trouble
of recommending it...

sukkiri gag rendered 'refreshed' throughout (choices c00853/c00854 'Get refreshed' / 'Don't get refreshed').
